items.text: Saints WR Chris Olave (hamstring) is active vs Ravens after expected-to-play reports.
items.why: Schefter confirmation; prior sources said expected with no major docks.
items.implication: Clean WR2/3 role, full snap expectation.

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow, listed questionable with back, is officially active and will start vs Texans.
items.why: Official inactive list confirmation after weekend expected-to-play reports.
items.implication: Full QB1 start; no docks expected beyond normal matchup.

items.text: Projecting Ladd McConkey (cracked rib) in with decent injury docks; Rapoport tone bullish, official status likely ~2:30pm ET; flak jacket if plays. Team did not elevate WR.
items.why: Practiced Friday, improved steadily, pushing to play, optimism barring setback; Schefter flak jacket note.
items.implication: Risky WR2/3 with docks if active; QJ/Harris upside if out.
items.opportunity: Primary target if full; monitor warmups/inactives.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers (hamstring) officially OUT after Saturday downgrade.
items.why: Saturday official downgrade confirmed across reports.
items.implication: Opens targets for Bateman/Andrews/Likely; zero production.
items.opportunity: Elevated WR2/TE usage in Ravens offense.

items.text: Steelers WR Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) downgraded to OUT for Sunday vs Patriots.
items.implication: Opens snaps/targets for Roman Wilson/Germie Bernard and other Steelers WRs.

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins (hamstring) ruled out for Week 2.
items.why: Confirmed across injury trackers and Sunday reports.
items.implication: Targets to other HOU WRs/Schultz; Burrow matchup still viable.
items.opportunity: Waiver/streamer bump for HOU pass catchers.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers (knee) doubtful this week; could return next week. Elevated Myarick.
items.why: GameDay report; Saturday elevation of backup.
items.implication: Sit this week; stash for return. Mayer/Myarick short-term.

items.text: ETR Sunday AM summary: McConkey GTD optimism+flak; Nacua GTD; Harvey not expected; Olave/Burrow/Black/McMillan expected (McMillan snap count); Flowers/Pittman OUT.
items.implication: Core status board for early slate decisions.

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua (hip) is a true pre-game/GTD decision for MNF vs Giants; different injury from camp psoas.
items.why: No practice second straight day; Rams view as pregame.
items.implication: Have pivot ready; if out heavier TE (Ferguson/Parkinson) and Mumpfield/Fields.

items.text: Broncos RB RJ Harvey (hamstring) unlikely to play vs Jaguars despite questionable tag.
items.why: Source confirms unlikely; ETR/Levitan align on not expected.
items.implication: Opens look at Jonah Coleman or other Broncos RBs.

items.text: Agrees with Germie Bernard as deep stash/love with Pittman out; good fit for McCarthy offense, YAC.
items.implication: Deep league add for potential surprise role.

items.text: Loves Kenneth Walker vs IND: 74% snaps, 40% route targets Week 1 (tied team lead); Indy just gave up big to Henry. RB4 with RB1 upside.
items.why: Elite utilization and soft run matchup.

items.text: Loves Ashton Jeanty @ LAC: 99 utilization Week 1 (tied Bijan), 19% target share recent, 25+ touches frequent.
Loves Bucky Irving vs CLE: high utilization, 26% target share, all RB RZ touches Week 1; CLE soft vs run.
Loves Justin Jefferson @ CHI: 37% target share from Wentz W1; strong historical with Wentz; Bears soft vs WR.
Loves Dak Prescott vs WAS: home smash, WAS torched in W1, high implied total.
items.why: Home efficiency + opponent pass D woes + total.

items.text: Hates Travis Etienne @ BAL: concerning W1 usage split with Miller; Kamara expected back squeezes role further; underdog script.
Hates Marvin Harrison Jr. vs SEA: only 8% target share W1 (5th on team), zero RZ; SEA tough vs WR.
